value.text:
Linemen do not win trophies. Jakeem Friend won seven rings instead.

For most of his career he was a Seattle Seahawk, a fixture up front through the Modern era. He played 273 games and was credited with 557 blocks, two a game, every game, without a single MVP or Player of the Year award to show for it. That is how the job works. The reward is a quarterback who gets up clean and a running back who finds the hole where it was supposed to be.

The last four seasons have come in New York, with the Jets from Y79 to Y82, and two of those rings were won there. The jersey changed. The job did not, and Seattle still has first claim on him.

Seven rings, 557 blocks, and almost no headlines. Jakeem Friend, Seahawks legend, welcome to the Hall of Fame.
